name: Registration validates input and creates a unique customer
description: Verify registration validation and successful backend persistence using a unique timestamp-based email and phone.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /daftar and submit the empty form.
Verify validation messages are shown for required identity, contact, password, confirmation, and terms fields.

Fill a valid registration using name TestSprite Customer, a unique email testsprite+<current timestamp>@example.com, a unique valid Indonesian phone beginning 0899, password TestSprite#2026, matching confirmation, accept terms, and submit.
Verify Akun berhasil dibuat is displayed and the submitted customer name is preserved.
Navigate to login and sign in using the newly created email and password.
Verify the authenticated Akun saya page opens with the newly created customer identity.
